name: Matchbox
description: Guidelines for traveling with a matchbox on a plane.

carryOn.reason: One book or box of safety matches is allowed in carry-on baggage or on your person. Strike-anywhere matches are completely prohibited.

checkedBag.reason: Matchboxes are prohibited in checked baggage by TSA and IATA regulations.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring a matchbox on a plane?

travelTips: Carry the matchbox in your pocket or top of your carry-on bag for easy access at security

faq.question: Can I bring a matchbox on a plane?
faq.answer: Yes, one small box of safety matches is allowed in carry-on baggage or on your person. Strike-anywhere matches are prohibited entirely.

faq.question: Are matchboxes allowed in checked baggage?
faq.answer: No. Matchboxes are prohibited in checked baggage. You must carry them in your carry-on or on your person.
